title: DRLAlgoMapfree: Reproducibility Repository for DRL Algorithms in Map-Free Robot Navigation
description: Reproducibility repository for the IEEE Access article "A Comparative Study of DRL Algorithms for Map-Free Robot Navigation With Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer". The repository provides a Python-based training and evaluation pipeline for comparing PPO, SAC, A2C, TD3, and DDPG in map-free mobile robot navigation, with supporting material for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer experiments.
references: Yilmaz, T., and Aydogmus, O. (2026). A Comparative Study of DRL Algorithms for Map-Free Robot Navigation With Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer. IEEE Access, 14, 60268-60284. https://doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3684520
